Name: Asterisk's Alternative Textures Tools Retexture
Author: Asterisk555
Description:
[u]Description[/u]
[list]
[*]Simple mod that changes the way the tools used in the Alternatives Textures framework look.
[*]I based the scissor sprite on ones for left handed people since the world needs more of those and I made them closed because you shouldn't run with open scissors kids.
[*]If you like this I do art commissions feel free to message me.
[/list]
[u]To Use[/u]
[list]
[*]To use just unzip into your mods folder.
[*]You can buy the tools in Robin's Carpenter shop and then you just click on whatever you want to change while the tool is selected.
[/list]I recommend using [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] if you like being able to change your config options without relaunching the game. For more information on what Alternative Texture is [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9246]click here[/url].

[u]Config options[/u]
[list]
[*]PaintBucket: true, false
[*]PaintBrush_Empty: true, false
[*]PaintBrush_Filled: true, false
[*]Scissors: Blue, Lefty, False
[/list]
[u]Compatibility[/u]
[list]
[*]Should only conflict with other mods that also specifically change the way the tools in Alternative Textures look, and a config file is included so you can switch individual tool retextures off by typing in "false". All are set to "true" by default.
[/list]
[u]Mods used in Video[/u]
[list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9923]Lambeeron's Oversized Sleeves[/url]﻿
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9408]Furniture Recolours[/url]﻿
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9852]Hojichas Seaside Furniture and Wallpapers and Floors for Alternative Textures[/url]
[*]And personal conversions to AT of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8088]Solip's coop animals[/url]﻿, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8088]Elle's New Coop Animals[/url]﻿﻿, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9057]Farm Animal Facelift[/url]﻿, [url=https://www.moddrop.com/stardew-valley/mods/688256-eemies-animals-for-bfav]Eemie's Animals for BFAV[/url]﻿, and a few other mods including those from Nexus, Naver and some personal edits. If you want some tips for making your own conversion packs check out the [url=https://github.com/Floogen/AlternativeTextures/wiki/Creating-a-Content-Pack]Alternative Textures Wiki[/url]﻿ and I've also created a page showing what tools I use to make my own personal conversions [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9834]here[/url]﻿.
[/list]
